title: Italian Green Bean Tagine
description: A creative Italian twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine, featuring green beans and naturally sweet flavors.
instructions: 1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the green beans for 5 minutes.
2. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
4. Add the shallots and cook for 2 minutes, until softened.
5. Add the green beans and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
6. Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
7. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
